M1 - Dribble
M2 - Shoot
Q - Slide Tackle
R - Weapon

G - Flow
V - Charge Stamina
SHIFT - Run
CTRL - Shift-Lock

Z - Dive Left
F - Hand Block

!training on/off

!admin playername
!flyperms playername
!fly
!ball
